name: Ukraine
people: Where Ukrainians and Co-designers design the nation they want to live in.
codesigner: Everyone who shares a vision, a voice or an enterprise here becomes a Co-designer of Perfect Ukraine: one of a community of selfless people, at home and abroad, building a nation where every citizen has a decent life.

portrait.alt: Ukraine in Bloom, nation portrait of Ukraine
portrait.title: Ukraine in Bloom

paras: Blue sky above yellow wheat: the plainest flag in Europe and one of the bravest. Even at war, nine in ten of your young people complete school and almost all of you have a safe toilet and clean fuel.
letter.quote: “You have kept a nation standing under fire. Now let every Ukrainian family count on a full table.”

mandates.terms: For the Government of Ukraine, its development partners and investors. Scope and fees are agreed in writing before any work begins.

capita.pc_text: The yearly cost, per person, of lifting everyone above the Living Line in all seven basic living standards, set with Ukraine in its own prices.
capita.price_text: Perfect Capita times the population: the national bill, each year.
capita.est: Perfect Nations estimate, to be confirmed with Ukraine. Figures marked dated rest on surveys more than five years old; lenient measures are marked as such.
capita.measures: Strict measures. Food: share not moderately or severely food insecure (FAO). Water: safely managed drinking water where measured; where it is not, basic water, marked as such. Shelter: the lower of safely managed sanitation and the share outside urban slums. Energy: the lower of electricity per person against 1,000 kWh and clean cooking. Education: the lower of children reading by the end of primary school and lower-secondary completion. Health: WHO service coverage index. Livelihood: share above the stricter of the national poverty line and the World Bank line for the nation’s income group. Each figure links to its source.

voices.local: We are looking for the people with real stories from Ukraine: the leaders who built something that works, and the keepers of local knowledge who know how their communities live, cope and thrive.

close_lead: Share your vision, suggest a guest, or write to us. Every message receives a personal reply.
sources: World Bank, World Development Indicators: population 2025, urban share, agricultural and forest land, renewable fresh water per person and renewable energy share, read 30 October 2026.

Strict Perfect Capita inputs: FAO food insecurity, WHO/UNICEF water and sanitation, World Bank clean cooking, learning poverty and poverty lines, UNESCO completion and the WHO service coverage index (2023, via Our World in Data).
